items.title: A small but growing number of founders are betting on bringing people together offline
items.feed_excerpt: Brynn Putnam and Tristan Walker have already done something that most founders only dream about: created companies so compelling that bigger outfits bought them. Putnam, a trained ballerina with a small chain of boutique studios, built the connected-fitness company Mirror and sold it to Lululemon for $500 million in cash less than three years later. […]

items.title: New California law will penalize influencers who don’t disclose political ads
items.feed_excerpt: The new legislation adds teeth to disclosure requirements for online influencers who are paid to post about politics.
